<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def glyphs(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return ''.join('B' if a[44][21+5*i]=='B' else 'w' for i in range(5))
def bar(f): return f.ascii.split('\n')[1].count('b')
print("start:", glyphs(current_frame), "bar:", bar(current_frame), "step:", current_frame.step)
# Try single-on patterns: T1, T2, T4, T5 (T3 already tried)
targets = {'T1':'Bwwww','T2':'wBwww','T4':'wwwBw','T5':'wwwwB'}
for name,t in targets.items():
    cur = glyphs(current_frame)
    clicks=[]
    for i in range(5):
        want = t[i]=='B'
        have = cur[i]=='B'
        if want!=have:
            clicks.append(21+5*i)
    if clicks:
        action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':44,'col':c} for c in clicks])
    g = glyphs(current_frame)
    done = last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('run_complete')
    print(name, "->", g, "bar:", bar(current_frame), "completed:", done)
    if done: break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def glyphs(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return ''.join('B' if a[44][21+5*i]=='B' else 'w' for i in range(5))
def bar(f): return f.ascii.split('\n')[1].count('b')
print("start:", glyphs(current_frame), "bar:", bar(current_frame), "step:", current_frame.step)
# Try single-on patterns: T1, T2, T4, T5 (T3 already tried)
targets = {'T1':'Bwwww','T2':'wBwww','T4':'wwwBw','T5':'wwwwB'}
for name,t in targets.items():
    cur = glyphs(current_frame)
    clicks=[]
    for i in range(5):
        want = t[i]=='B'
        have = cur[i]=='B'
        if want!=have:
            clicks.append(21+5*i)
    if clicks:
        action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':44,'col':c} for c in clicks])
    g = glyphs(current_frame)
    done = last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('run_complete')
    print(name, "->", g, "bar:", bar(current_frame), "completed:", done)
    if done: break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
